full_list.title_en: Uncertainty-Aware End-to-End AI Weather Forecasting: Disentangling Observation and Model Contributions
full_list.title_zh: 具有不确定性感知的端到端人工智能天气预报：解耦观测与模型贡献
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: End-to-end weather forecasting systems produce skillful global gridded and station forecasts directly from raw Earth observations, replacing the numerical weather prediction pipeline, including data assimilation, at a fraction of its cost. These systems are deterministic and issue no uncertainty. Here we render the Aardvark Weather model probabilistic by attaching one stochastic mechanism to each component: learned, input-dependent noise at the observation encoder, capturing aleatoric uncertainty inherited from the observing system, and Monte Carlo dropout in the processor, capturing epistemic uncertainty in the learned dynamics. The resulting nested ensemble attributes forecast spread to the two sources through a law-of-total-variance decomposition, cross-checked by withholding observation streams. Probabilistic finetuning significantly improves the mean forecast, by 4.2% on average across variables and lead times. The ensemble is calibrated against ERA5 through the medium range (spread-skill ratio 0.98), keeps station RMSE within 2.4% of the deterministic model while beating it in CRPS at every lead time, and trails the operational ECMWF ensemble. The encoder branch behaves as observation-driven uncertainty. Component-attributed uncertainty makes end-to-end forecasts more transparent, a step toward observation-driven digital twins of the atmosphere.
full_list.abstract_zh: 端到端天气预报系统能够直接从原始地球观测生成全球网格和站点预报，但传统系统通常是确定性的，无法给出不确定性。本文通过在观测编码器中引入输入依赖的随机噪声、在处理器中采用蒙特卡洛随机失活，使Aardvark Weather模型实现概率化，并利用全方差定律分解两类不确定性来源。概率微调改善了平均预报和概率预报表现，且编码器分支所表征的不确定性主要由观测驱动，从而提高了端到端天气预报的透明度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 端到端天气预报系统能够直接从原始地球观测生成具有良好预报技巧的全球网格预报和站点预报，以远低于数值天气预报成本的方式取代包括资料同化在内的数值天气预报流程。这些系统是确定性的，无法给出不确定性。本文通过为各个组成部分分别附加一种随机机制，使Aardvark Weather模型实现概率化：在观测编码器中加入学习得到的、依赖输入的噪声，用于刻画从观测系统继承而来的偶然不确定性；在处理器中使用蒙特卡洛随机失活，用于刻画学习到的动力学中的认知不确定性。所得嵌套集合利用全方差定律将预报离散度归因于这两种来源，并通过屏蔽观测流进行交叉检验。概率微调显著改善了平均预报，在所有变量和预报时效上的平均改善幅度为4.2%。在中期预报范围内，该集合相对于ERA5实现了良好校准，其离散度—技巧比为0.98；站点均方根误差保持在确定性模型的2.4%以内，同时在每个预报时效上的连续排序概率评分（CRPS）均优于确定性模型。尽管如此，其表现仍落后于业务运行的ECMWF集合预报。编码器分支表现出观测驱动的不确定性特征。对不确定性进行组成部分归因提高了端到端预报的透明度，是迈向由观测驱动的大气数字孪生的重要一步。
full_list.summary: 端到端天气预报系统能够直接从原始地球观测生成全球网格和站点预报，但传统系统通常是确定性的，无法给出不确定性。本文通过在观测编码器中引入输入依赖的随机噪声、在处理器中采用蒙特卡洛随机失活，使Aardvark Weather模型实现概率化，并利用全方差定律分解两类不确定性来源。概率微调改善了平均预报和概率预报表现，且编码器分支所表征的不确定性主要由观测驱动，从而提高了端到端天气预报的透明度。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：蒙特卡洛统计采样。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《具有不确定性感知的端到端人工智能天气预报：解耦观测与模型贡献》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Giant staggered Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya vectors emerged in synthetic antiferromagnets with spatially alternating stress
full_list.title_zh: 具有空间交替应力的合成反铁磁体中出现的巨大交错 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 矢量
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction is a source of chiral magnetic physics, and it manifests microstructural symmetry which could link to exotic magnetic and electronic properties such as altermagnetism. For a new paradigm in magnetism and spintronics, it is crucial to have control on the DM interaction as well as ordering of the DM vectors which characterize the DM interaction. Here, we report on a strong interlayer DM interaction emerged in Co/Ru magnetic superlattices whose structural symmetry is unambiguously broken by alternating mechanical strains developed using the peculiar technique of our stress mechanism. Moreover, theoretical analyses reveal that our magnetic superlattices host a staggered order of the DM vectors. Our results indicate that the spatially varying strains with our breakthrough technique are quite effective in breaking the symmetry of the system and prove that it can control the DM interaction strength as well as the DM vector order.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文报道了 Co/Ru 磁性超晶格中的强层间 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用，该体系通过交替机械应变明确破坏结构对称性。理论分析表明，这些磁性超晶格具有交错排列的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 矢量。结果说明，空间变化的应力能够有效破坏体系对称性，并同时调控 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的强度及其矢量有序方式。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用是手性磁学现象的来源之一，它体现了微观结构对称性，并可能与交替磁性等奇异磁性和电子性质相联系。对于磁学和自旋电子学的新范式而言，实现对 DM 相互作用以及刻画该相互作用的 DM 矢量排列的控制至关重要。在这里，我们报道了 Co/Ru 磁性超晶格中的强层间 DM 相互作用；该超晶格通过采用我们应力机制中的特殊技术形成交替机械应变，从而明确破坏了结构对称性。此外，理论分析表明，我们的磁性超晶格具有 DM 矢量的交错有序。我们的结果表明，利用这种突破性的技术产生空间变化的应力，对于破坏体系对称性非常有效，并证明该方法能够同时控制 DM 相互作用的强度以及 DM 矢量的有序方式。
full_list.summary: 本文报道了 Co/Ru 磁性超晶格中的强层间 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用，该体系通过交替机械应变明确破坏结构对称性。理论分析表明，这些磁性超晶格具有交错排列的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 矢量。结果说明，空间变化的应力能够有效破坏体系对称性，并同时调控 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的强度及其矢量有序方式。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文在具有空间交替应力的Co/Ru人工反铁磁超晶格中观察到强层间Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，并通过理论分析揭示DM矢量的交错有序。结果表明，应变诱导的结构对称性破缺能够同时调控DM相互作用强度和其矢量排布。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用、磁性超晶格、应变工程、交替磁性和自旋电子学方向高度直接相关。该工作尤其契合通过对称性分析和自旋哈密顿量设计可控手性磁相的研究路线。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可跟进交错DM矢量对非互易自旋波、斯格明子稳定性及交替磁性输运的影响，并以第一性原理提取交换参数后结合自旋动力学模拟验证。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《具有空间交替应力的合成反铁磁体中出现的巨大交错 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 矢量》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Heterogeneous ferroelectricity and conductivity of oxidized BaTiO₃ crystals: the role of nanoscale phase segregation in the surface region
full_list.title_zh: 氧化 BaTiO₃ 晶体的非均匀铁电性与导电性：表面区域纳米尺度相偏析的作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the effect of thermal oxidation on BaTiO₃ single crystals. Our results reveal that, even at moderate temperatures of up to 1000 degC, complex segregation mechanisms occur involving the movement of Ba-rich compounds to the upper surface, where they form inhomogeneously distributed BaO nanocrystals. As a result, deeper regions of the surface layer become depleted in Ba and become TiO₂-rich. A sandwich-like structure evolves in the surface layer, exhibiting a measurable electromotive force and self-polarization. This, in turn, screens the polarization and diminishes the global ferroelectric response. The conductivity is also strongly influenced by the irreversible segregation effects in the surface region. An as-received crystal can be transformed into a metallic state, while oxidation induces semiconducting properties and prevents a return to the metallic state upon subsequent reduction. Nanoscale analysis demonstrates that the conductivity is channeled to filaments forming along dislocations, whose local chemical composition changes upon reduction and oxidation even at moderate temperatures due to preferential Ba and O pipe diffusion thus determining the electric behavior of the whole sample.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究考察热氧化对 BaTiO₃ 单晶的影响，发现即使温度不超过1000摄氏度，也会发生复杂偏析：富钡化合物迁移至上表面并形成分布不均的 BaO 纳米晶，而更深的表层区域则贫钡、富 TiO₂。表层由此形成具有电动势和自极化的夹层结构，屏蔽极化并削弱整体铁电响应。不可逆偏析还显著改变导电性，并使导电通道集中于沿位错形成、成分受还原和氧化影响的细丝。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了热氧化对 BaTiO₃ 单晶的影响。结果表明，即使在不超过1000摄氏度的中等温度下，也会发生复杂的偏析机制，涉及富钡化合物向上表面迁移，并在那里形成非均匀分布的 BaO 纳米晶。结果，表层中更深的区域会耗尽 Ba 并变得富含 TiO₂。表面层中演化出一种夹层状结构，表现出可测量的电动势和自极化。这反过来会屏蔽极化并减弱整体铁电响应。导电性也受到表面区域不可逆偏析效应的强烈影响。原始接收的晶体可转变为金属态，而氧化会诱导半导体性质，并阻止其在后续还原时返回金属态。纳米尺度分析表明，导电性被限制在沿位错形成的细丝中；由于 Ba 和 O 的优先管道扩散，即使在中等温度下，这些细丝的局部化学成分也会随还原和氧化而改变，从而决定整个样品的电学行为。

full_list.title_en: Switchable Magnetoelectric Transport in Graphene via a Van der Waals Multiferroic
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Switchable Magnetoelectric Transport in Graphene via a Van der Waals Multiferroic
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric and magnetic control of transport properties at atomic interfaces is central to the development of next generation electronics and spintronics. Van der Waals multiferroics materials that simultaneously host dielectric and magnetic orders down to the monolayer limit offer a promising platform for such interfacial control, yet the realization of electronic functionalities that exploit the unique attributes of van der Waals multiferroics has largely remained elusive. Here, we realize a van der Waals heterostructure comprising graphene and the multiferroic CuCrP2S6, enabling gate-switchable magnetoelectric transport in graphene, mediated by the multiferroic layer. The charge-neutrality resistance peak of graphene exhibits pronounced hysteresis arising from polarization flip in the multiferroic state. Application of an in-plane magnetic field shifts this peak in a polarization-dependent manner, revealing magnetic-field-induced polarization modulation a direct signature of the magnetoelectric effect. Furthermore, cooling the device under an applied electric field enables domain control of the multiferroic order, allowing reversible switching of the interfacial magnetoelectric transport. These results provide the first demonstration of interfacial magnetoelectric transport in a vdW heterostructure, and establish a pathway for engineering two-dimensional van der Waals interfaces for functional device applications.

full_list.title_en: Terahertz Control of Optical Second-Harmonic Generation in Displacive Ferroelectrics: Electronic Bloch-State Reconstruction
full_list.title_zh: 位移型铁电体中太赫兹调控光学二次谐波产生：电子布洛赫态重构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical second-harmonic generation (SHG) is a powerful probe of ferroelectric order, yet its microscopic origin and dynamical control are often understood primarily from symmetry considerations rather than from the underlying electronic processes. Here, we develop a microscopic theory of terahertz-controlled optical SHG in displacive ferroelectrics, establishing a direct connection between THz-driven polar lattice distortions and the resulting electronic nonlinear optical response. Starting from a complete Bloch-band representation, we show that an inversion-breaking lattice distortion reconstructs electronic Bloch wave functions, modifies optical dipole matrix elements, and activates nonlinear optical pathways that are forbidden in the centrosymmetric structure. We derive the second-order susceptibility in terms of the distortion-induced reconstruction of electronic states and optical transition matrix elements, and demonstrate that the electronic SHG susceptibility is linear in the polar distortion, χ⁽²⁾(bf Q)proptobf Q, leading to an SHG intensity quadratic in the inversion-breaking order parameter. When the polar mode is coherently driven by a terahertz electric field, the resulting time-dependent lattice distortion dynamically reconstructs the electronic states and thereby modulates the optical SHG response, with I₂ω(t)propto|bf Q(t)|² to leading order. This framework distinguishes the THz-driven lattice dynamics from the electronic interband processes responsible for optical SHG, which is particularly important in insulating ferroelectrics where low-energy carrier dynamics are absent. Our theory thus provides a microscopic bridge between nonequilibrium polar lattice dynamics and ultrafast electronic nonlinear optics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 光学二次谐波产生是探测铁电有序的重要手段，但其微观电子机制与动态调控尚未被充分阐明。本文建立了太赫兹驱动极性晶格畸变与电子非线性光学响应之间的微观理论联系。理论表明，二阶非线性极化率与极性畸变线性相关，而二次谐波强度与破缺反演对称的序参量平方成正比。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 光学二次谐波产生（SHG）是探测铁电有序的强有力工具，但人们对其微观起源和动态调控的理解，通常主要基于对称性考量，而非其底层电子过程。本文建立了位移型铁电体中太赫兹调控光学SHG的微观理论，在太赫兹驱动的极性晶格畸变与由此产生的电子非线性光学响应之间建立了直接联系。从完备的布洛赫能带表象出发，我们表明，破坏反演对称性的晶格畸变会重构电子布洛赫波函数，改变光学偶极矩阵元，并激活在中心对称结构中被禁止的非线性光学路径。我们将二阶极化率表述为电子态与光学跃迁矩阵元的畸变诱导重构，并证明电子SHG极化率与极性畸变呈线性关系，即χ⁽²⁾(Q)正比于Q，从而使SHG强度与破坏反演对称性的序参量平方成正比。当极性模被太赫兹电场相干驱动时，产生的时间依赖晶格畸变会动态重构电子态，进而调制光学SHG响应；在最低阶近似下，I₂ω(t)正比于|Q(t)|²。该框架区分了太赫兹驱动的晶格动力学与负责光学SHG的电子带间过程；这在缺乏低能载流子动力学的绝缘铁电体中尤其重要。因此，我们的理论在非平衡极性晶格动力学与超快电子非线性光学之间搭建了一座微观桥梁。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Light-induced topological phase transitions and anomalous thermal transport in d-wave altermagnets》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Fractal Confinement and Magnetic Self-sabotage of Current Flow: Electrons Near the Metal-insulator Crossover in a 2D δ-layer
full_list.title_zh: 分形限域与电流的磁性自我阻断：二维 δ 掺杂层中接近金属-绝缘体交叉的电子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28739v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study low-T transport and itinerant magnetism in 2D δ-doped semiconductors. Large-scale Hartree-Fock calculations with random hoppings and repulsion U₀ reveal two transport regimes near a critical density. The conductivity σ(T) initially increases as T drops below U₀ / 10. However, at T sim U₀/100, a tiny density of magnetic moments forms, driving an insulating downturn. Fractal wavefunctions locally amplify magnetic interactions, initially concentrating currents into branched filaments, but ultimately choking them off via dynamic SU(2) symmetry breaking.
full_list.abstract_zh: 作者研究二维 δ 掺杂半导体在低温下的输运与巡游磁性，并通过含随机跃迁和排斥相互作用的大尺度 Hartree-Fock 计算发现临界密度附近存在两种输运阶段。电导率在温度降至 U₀/10 以下时先升高，但在约 U₀/100 时，极少量磁矩的形成会引发绝缘性下降。分形波函数先将电流集中到分叉丝状通道中，同时放大局域磁相互作用；最终，动态 SU(2) 对称性破缺会阻断这些通道。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了二维 δ 掺杂半导体中的低温输运和巡游磁性。具有随机跃迁和排斥相互作用 U₀ 的大尺度 Hartree-Fock 计算揭示了临界密度附近的两种输运状态。随着温度降至 U₀/10 以下，电导率 σ(T) 起初升高。然而，在温度约为 U₀/100 时，极低密度的磁矩形成，并驱动体系出现向绝缘态转变的下降趋势。分形波函数会在局域上增强磁相互作用，最初使电流集中于分叉的丝状通道中，但最终会通过动态 SU(2) 对称性破缺将这些电流通道阻断。
full_list.summary: 作者研究二维 δ 掺杂半导体在低温下的输运与巡游磁性，并通过含随机跃迁和排斥相互作用的大尺度 Hartree-Fock 计算发现临界密度附近存在两种输运阶段。电导率在温度降至 U₀/10 以下时先升高，但在约 U₀/100 时，极少量磁矩的形成会引发绝缘性下降。分形波函数先将电流集中到分叉丝状通道中，同时放大局域磁相互作用；最终，动态 SU(2) 对称性破缺会阻断这些通道。
full_list.focus_summary: 本文利用含随机跃迁和库仑排斥的二维δ掺杂半导体大尺度Hartree-Fock计算，研究金属-绝缘体转变附近的低温输运和巡游磁性。结果表明，低温下少量磁矩的形成会导致动态SU(2)对称性破缺，使原本集中的分形电流通道受到抑制并出现绝缘性电导下降。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的巡游磁性、二维材料、自旋相互作用、量子输运和磁性有效模型方向直接相关。其将分形波函数、局域磁矩形成与输运退化联系起来，为研究无序、电子关联和磁性共同作用下的二维半导体输运提供了有价值的理论视角。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步采用第一性原理参数化的自旋-电子或自旋-晶格模型，检验具体二维材料和掺杂半导体中该机制的适用性。建议结合有限温度蒙特卡洛、自旋动力学和量子输运计算，研究磁矩涨落、无序强度及载流子密度对临界输运行为的影响。
full_list.method_point: 论文采用含随机跃迁、局域排斥相互作用和自洽磁场的二维δ掺杂层大尺度Hartree-Fock计算，在不同载流子密度和低温区间求解空间非均匀电子态。计算重点是金属—绝缘体交叉附近的电导随温度变化、分形波函数的电流分叉通道以及少量局域磁矩形成后的自洽SU(2)对称性破缺；磁性反馈被用于解释电流通道由增强输运转为自我阻断。
full_list.related_work: 它与无序电子体系的渗流、Anderson局域化、Hubbard模型和DMFT研究相呼应，但强调分形电流网络放大局域磁相互作用的空间机制，而不是只用平均电阻描述交叉。与团队方向的联系主要在Xin-Gao Gong的输运和量子材料模拟、Hongjun Xiang的自旋哈密顿量与蒙特卡洛，以及Ji-Hui Yang对半导体缺陷和载流子输运的研究；方法上尚未引入图神经网络或第一性原理参数化。
full_list.implication: 可把该机制迁移到含缺陷和δ掺杂的Si、SiC或GaN薄层：用DFT计算掺杂间距、缺陷电荷、局域库仑参数和自旋交换，再建立含无序跃迁的Hubbard或紧束缚模型。对不同密度、温度、外磁场和栅压进行自洽Hartree-Fock及量子输运计算，采用NEGF得到电导和局域电流图；用等变GNN学习局域磁矩与跃迁参数，并以扫描探针磁信号和低温电阻标度验证。

full_list.title_en: Direct Evidence of Unconventional Superconductivity in Doped Kagome system RV₃Sb₅
full_list.title_zh: 掺杂 Kagome 体系 RV₃Sb₅ 中非常规超导性的直接证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The superconducting pairing symmetry of kagome metals remains a central unresolved question largely because phase-sensitive experiments capable of distinguishing between different possible order parameters have been difficult to implement. The spatial and energetic characteristics of impurity bound states measured by spectroscopic-imaging scanning tunneling microscopy encode information on the superconducting order parameter. Here, we use impurity-bound state spectroscopy to investigate optimally doped RbV₃Sb₅ where the charge-density wave instability is fully suppressed. We find that the superconducting state is fully gapped and exhibits two distinct energy scales, consistent with a multiband order parameter. Atomic-scale spectroscopy around nonmagnetic defects reveals pronounced particle-hole asymmetric bound states. Comparison with theoretical calculations demonstrates that these bound states are incompatible with conventional s-wave and sign-changing s± pairing. Our calculations also show that the data are fully consistent with a chiral order parameter. Our results establish impurity-bound-state spectroscopy as a powerful phase-sensitive probe of superconductivity in kagome materials and provide strong evidence that optimally doped RbV₃Sb₅ realizes a fully gapped chiral superconducting state.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文利用杂质束缚态谱研究电荷密度波不稳定性已完全抑制的最佳掺杂 RbV₃Sb₅。该超导态具有完全能隙和两个不同能标，符合多带序参量特征；非磁性缺陷周围还出现显著的粒子-空穴不对称束缚态。理论比较表明，这些束缚态不兼容常规 s 波和变号 s± 配对，但与手性序参量完全一致，为 RbV₃Sb₅ 实现完全能隙手性超导态提供了有力证据。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: Kagome 金属的超导配对对称性仍是一个核心未决问题，主要原因在于能够区分不同可能序参量的相敏感实验一直难以实现。通过谱成像扫描隧道显微镜测量的杂质束缚态的空间和能量特征，可以编码有关超导序参量的信息。在这里，我们利用杂质束缚态谱研究最佳掺杂的 RbV₃Sb₅，其中电荷密度波不稳定性已被完全抑制。我们发现，该超导态具有完全能隙，并表现出两个不同的能量尺度，这与多带序参量相一致。在非磁性缺陷周围进行的原子尺度谱测量揭示了显著的粒子-空穴不对称束缚态。与理论计算的比较表明，这些束缚态与常规 s 波配对和变号 s± 配对均不相容。我们的计算还显示，实验数据与手性序参量完全一致。我们的结果确立了杂质束缚态谱作为 Kagome 材料中超导性的有力相敏感探针，并为最佳掺杂 RbV₃Sb₅ 实现完全能隙手性超导态提供了强有力的证据。
full_list.summary: 本文利用杂质束缚态谱研究电荷密度波不稳定性已完全抑制的最佳掺杂 RbV₃Sb₅。该超导态具有完全能隙和两个不同能标，符合多带序参量特征；非磁性缺陷周围还出现显著的粒子-空穴不对称束缚态。理论比较表明，这些束缚态不兼容常规 s 波和变号 s± 配对，但与手性序参量完全一致，为 RbV₃Sb₅ 实现完全能隙手性超导态提供了有力证据。
full_list.focus_summary: 本文利用杂质束缚态谱研究掺杂RbV3Sb5中的超导配对对称性，并结合理论计算分析杂质诱导的电子态。实验结果支持具有两个能标的全能隙多带超导，并表明其与手性序参量相容，而不支持常规s波或s±配对。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队关注的超导、kagome金属、磁性和拓扑量子功能材料直接相关。其对杂质束缚态、配对对称性和拓扑超导的结合分析，可为第一性原理电子结构、有效模型和拓扑性质研究提供物理问题与验证思路。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步开展Rb、K、Cs基kagome金属中缺陷、应变和电荷序对超导配对及拓扑边界态的第一性原理和有效哈密顿量研究。也可结合机器学习筛选具有手性超导或多带超导候选的层状材料。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《掺杂 Kagome 体系 RV₃Sb₅ 中非常规超导性的直接证据》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Evolving charge order in the CDW state of AV₃Sb₅ metals
full_list.title_zh: AV₃Sb₅金属电荷密度波态中不断演化的电荷序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.29142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AV₃Sb₅ kagome metals are characterized by intertwined electronic and structural orders, which motivated extensive studies in recent years. Yet the details of the electronic state preceding the superconducting phase remain poorly understood. Here we extend our previous investigation [Phys. Rev. Research 7, L032046 (2025)] of RbV₃Sb₅ using avoided level crossing (ALC) muon-spin spectroscopy to the A = Cs and K systems. Consistent with our previous study, we identify a second transition whose origin cannot be attributed solely to an internal magnetic field, indicating the involvement of an additional electronic mechanism that subtly modifies the charge distribution within the V plane. In particular, the ALC results point towards an additional charge modulation taking place within the charge density wave (CDW) phase and occurring at T*
full_list.abstract_zh: AV₃Sb₅笼目金属具有交织的电子序与结构序，但其进入超导相之前的电子态仍缺乏清晰认识。本文将此前对RbV₃Sb₅的避免能级交叉缪子自旋谱研究扩展到A=Cs和K的体系。研究发现存在第二个转变，其起源不能仅归因于内部磁场，避免能级交叉结果指向电荷密度波相内一种额外的电荷调制，该调制发生在温度T*处并细微改变钒平面内的电荷分布。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: AV₃Sb₅笼目金属以交织的电子序和结构序为特征，这推动了近年来的大量研究。然而，在超导相之前出现的电子态的细节仍然缺乏充分理解。在这里，我们利用避免能级交叉（ALC）缪子自旋谱，将此前对RbV₃Sb₅的研究[Phys. Rev. Research 7, L032046 (2025)]扩展到A=Cs和K的体系。与我们此前的研究一致，我们识别出第二个转变，其起源不能仅仅归因于内部磁场，这表明还涉及一种额外的电子机制，该机制会细微地改变钒平面内的电荷分布。特别是，ALC结果指向在电荷密度波（CDW）相内发生的额外电荷调制，并且该调制发生在T*处。

full_list.focus_summary: 本文通过避免能级交叉缪子自旋谱研究AV3Sb5体系中的电荷密度波相。研究发现，Cs、K和Rb体系中均存在除内部磁场之外的第二个电子转变，暗示CDW相内还伴随额外的电荷调制。

full_list.title_en: Moiré-induced lattice reconstruction at buried atomic interfaces
full_list.title_zh: 莫尔诱导的埋藏原子界面晶格重构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30531v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic reconstruction at twisted two-dimensional interfaces governs many of their emergent optical, electronic, and mechanical properties, including sliding ferroelectricity. Despite recent progress in understanding lattice reconstruction in suspended twisted bilayers, structural changes at van der Waals heterointerfaces between multilayer crystals remain largely unexplored. Here we use multi-slice electron ptychography to non-invasively recover the three-dimensional atomic structure at marginally twisted rhombohedral interfaces between thick transition-metal dichalcogenide crystals. With a position precision of ~3 pm and a depth resolution ~1 nm, we resolve the twist-induced lattice reconstruction field per layer, and the resulting dislocation network at the buried interface. Despite the bulk nature, we observe markedly strong in-plane interfacial reconstruction due to suppression of the out-of-plane bending by outer layers, exceeding predictions from our three-dimensional modelling. Furthermore, we extract the strain tensor evolution during the decay of the reconstruction into the bulk, providing a structural foundation for understanding multi-layer moiré systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 扭转二维界面的原子重构决定其多种新兴光学、电子与力学性质，但厚多层晶体间范德华异质界面的结构变化仍少有研究。该工作采用多切片电子叠层衍射成像，非侵入式恢复了厚过渡金属二硫族化物晶体间微小扭转菱方界面的三维原子结构。研究分辨出逐层重构场和埋藏界面的位错网络，并发现因外层抑制面外弯曲而产生显著强于三维模型预测的面内界面重构。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 扭转二维界面处的原子重构控制着其许多新兴的光学、电子和力学性质，其中包括滑移铁电性。尽管近期在理解悬空扭转双层中的晶格重构方面取得了进展，多层晶体之间范德华异质界面处的结构变化仍在很大程度上未被探索。这里，我们利用多切片电子叠层衍射成像，以非侵入方式恢复了厚过渡金属二硫族化物晶体之间轻微扭转菱方界面的三维原子结构。凭借约3 pm的位置精度和约1 nm的深度分辨率，我们分辨了逐层的扭转诱导晶格重构场，以及埋藏界面处由此形成的位错网络。尽管体系具有体相性质，我们仍观察到显著强烈的面内界面重构，这是由于外层抑制了面外弯曲，其强度超过了我们的三维建模预测。此外，我们提取了重构向体相衰减过程中的应变张量演化，为理解多层莫尔体系提供了结构基础。
full_list.summary: 扭转二维界面的原子重构决定其多种新兴光学、电子与力学性质，但厚多层晶体间范德华异质界面的结构变化仍少有研究。该工作采用多切片电子叠层衍射成像，非侵入式恢复了厚过渡金属二硫族化物晶体间微小扭转菱方界面的三维原子结构。研究分辨出逐层重构场和埋藏界面的位错网络，并发现因外层抑制面外弯曲而产生显著强于三维模型预测的面内界面重构。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文利用多切片电子叠层成像重建厚层过渡金属硫族化物中弱扭转菱方界面的三维原子结构，解析了界面位错网络和逐层衰减的重构应变场。结果显示，外层对面外弯曲的抑制会增强埋藏界面的面内重构，其强度超过已有三维模型预测。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的莫尔材料、二维范德华体系、层间耦合、应变工程及滑移铁电性直接相关。该实验结构信息可为研究扭转界面中的极化、电子结构和畴结构提供可靠输入。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议关注重构场与局域堆垛、滑移铁电势能面及界面电荷分布的对应关系，并用机器学习势或第一性原理计算建立可扩展的原子尺度模型。

full_list.title_en: Pseudospin Dynamics of Charge Order
full_list.title_zh: 电荷有序的赝自旋动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge order is conventionally viewed as a static modulation of the electronic density, despite growing experimental capabilities to probe and manipulate its nonequilibrium evolution. In contrast to spin-ordered systems, a microscopic framework for charge-order dynamics and its control under external driving remains largely underdeveloped. Here, starting from an extended Hubbard model, we derive an effective pseudospin model in which the charge-ordered state maps onto staggered pseudospin order. The resulting charge-order dynamics is governed by Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert-like equations for the pseudospins, closely analogous to those of a bipartite antiferromagnet. We show that an external electric field directly controls the staggered pseudospin order and, above a threshold field, drives coherent reversal of the charge-order polarity by destabilizing collective pseudospin excitations. Our results establish the charge pseudospin as a microscopic dynamical degree of freedom for coherent switching and control of charge order, providing a charge-sector analogue of the well-established framework for spin-order dynamics in spintronics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电荷有序通常被视为静态电子密度调制，其非平衡动力学及外场调控的微观理论仍不完善。该研究从扩展 Hubbard 模型出发，将电荷有序映射为交错赝自旋序，并导出类似双亚晶格反铁磁体的 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 型动力学方程。外加电场可直接调控该序参量，并在超过阈值后通过失稳集体赝自旋激发实现电荷有序极性的相干翻转。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 尽管实验上探测和操控电荷有序非平衡演化的能力不断提高，电荷有序通常仍被视为电子密度的静态调制。与自旋有序体系相比，关于电荷有序动力学及其在外部驱动下调控的微观框架仍很不完善。这里，我们从一个扩展 Hubbard 模型出发，导出了一个有效赝自旋模型，其中电荷有序态映射为交错赝自旋有序。由此产生的电荷有序动力学由赝自旋的类 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程控制，与双亚晶格反铁磁体的动力学密切类似。我们表明，外加电场能够直接控制交错赝自旋序，并且在超过阈值场强后，通过使集体赝自旋激发失稳而驱动电荷有序极性的相干翻转。我们的结果确立了电荷赝自旋作为相干切换和控制电荷有序的微观动力学自由度，为自旋电子学中已充分建立的自旋有序动力学框架提供了电荷部门的对应物。
full_list.summary: 电荷有序通常被视为静态电子密度调制，其非平衡动力学及外场调控的微观理论仍不完善。该研究从扩展 Hubbard 模型出发，将电荷有序映射为交错赝自旋序，并导出类似双亚晶格反铁磁体的 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 型动力学方程。外加电场可直接调控该序参量，并在超过阈值后通过失稳集体赝自旋激发实现电荷有序极性的相干翻转。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作从扩展Hubbard模型推导有效赝自旋模型，将电荷有序态映射为交错赝自旋序。所得动力学方程类似双亚晶格反铁磁体的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程，并预测外加电场可通过集体赝自旋激发实现电荷序极性的相干翻转。
full_list.focus_relation: 该研究与团队的有效哈密顿量、自旋哈密顿量、自旋动力学、磁电耦合和电场驱动序参量翻转密切相关。虽然对象是电荷序而非传统磁序，但其赝自旋映射为研究电荷-自旋-晶格耦合及非平衡调控提供了可借鉴模型。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议核查有效模型参数与真实材料可观测量之间的对应关系，并关注阻尼和外场阈值的微观来源。可探索将该赝自旋动力学与第一性原理参数化、声子耦合或电荷密度波材料相结合。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《电荷有序的赝自旋动力学》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Topological Chiral Superconductivity in the Triangular-Lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard Model
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Topological Chiral Superconductivity in the Triangular-Lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard Model
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2509.02757v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Moiré materials provide exciting platforms for studying the interplay of strong electronic correlation and large magnetic flux effects. We study the lightly doped Hofstadter-Hubbard model on a triangular lattice through large-scale density matrix renormalization group and determinantal quantum Monte Carlo simulations. We find strong evidence for a robust chiral superconducting (SC) phase with dominant power-law pairing correlations and a quantized spin Chern number. The SC phase emerges at very weak interaction and grows stronger at intermediate interaction strengths (U ) for a wide range of hole doping. We also discuss the possible distinct nature of the normal state in different U regimes. Our work provides theoretical insights into the emergence of topological superconductivity from doping topological Chern bands or magnetic flux induced chiral spin liquid states of Moiré materials.
full_list.summary: 本文研究三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中的掺杂效应，使用密度矩阵重整化群和行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法分析莫尔材料中的强关联与磁通耦合。结果显示，在较宽掺杂范围内存在具有幂律配对关联和量子化自旋Chern数的手性超导相。

full_list.title_en: Superconductivity and Magnetism in Bi-Ni System: From Bulk to Heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: Bi-Ni 体系中的超导性与磁性：从块体到异质结构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity with ingredients of magnetism such as time reversal breaking, triplet pairing and proximity effects has been a long time pursued topic in physics and material science as a new source of innovative phenomena and effects to drive further scientific advances and technologies. The Bi-Ni system has emerged as a convenient candidate for the investigation of such phenomenology. Strictly speaking, the term Bi-Ni system refers to two different schemes, first to the NiBi₃ intermetallic compound, a 4 K superconductor in which a complex magnetism seems to govern electrical properties in the normal phase, but without implication in the superconducting properties. The second Bi-Ni system is not quite a material but a heterostructure formed by a bilayer of Bi and Ni. Here the superconducting phase has to steal the spotlight by showing strong evidence of time-reversal breaking and triplet pairing featuring a complex unconventional state. The ease of preparing the samples, compared to other candidates for such unconventionality, usually Uranium-based compounds, has accelerated the research in this system. Here, we went through a detailed review of the main results about the electronic properties of these two systems as well as a discussion of the main open questions to be solved in order to reach the complete understanding in this topic.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文综述 Bi-Ni 体系中的电子性质与超导磁性。该体系包括约 4 K 超导的金属间化合物 NiBi₃，以及由 Bi/Ni 双层形成的异质结构；前者正常态电性质似乎受复杂磁性控制，但磁性未影响超导性质，后者则显示出时间反演对称性破缺和三重态配对的强有力证据。作者还讨论了理解这一体系仍需解决的主要开放问题。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 含有磁性因素的非常规超导性，例如时间反演对称性破缺、三重态配对和邻近效应，长期以来一直是物理学和材料科学追求的研究主题，因为它可能产生推动科学进步与技术发展的新型现象和效应。Bi-Ni 体系已经成为研究这类现象的便利候选体系。严格来说，Bi-Ni 体系这一术语指代两种不同的体系：第一种是金属间化合物 NiBi₃，它是一种临界温度为 4 K 的超导体，其正常相中的电学性质似乎由复杂磁性主导，但这种磁性并未影响超导性质。第二种 Bi-Ni 体系并非严格意义上的材料，而是由 Bi 和 Ni 双层形成的异质结构。在该体系中，超导相成为研究重点，因为它显示出时间反演对称性破缺和三重态配对的强有力证据，并呈现复杂的非常规状态。与其他非常规超导候选材料，尤其是通常以铀为基础的化合物相比，该体系样品制备较为容易，这加速了对这一体系的研究。在本文中，我们详细回顾了这两个体系电子性质方面的主要结果，并讨论了为彻底理解这一主题仍需解决的主要开放问题。

full_list.title_en: Chiral Color Ice: Exact Local Handedness Constraints and Möbius Zero Modes in Frustrated Magnets
full_list.title_zh: 手性色冰：受挫磁体中的精确局域手性约束与莫比乌斯零模
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30802v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local constraints govern the low-energy physics of frustrated matter, but familiar ice-type rules constrain flux-like quantities and are insensitive to handedness. Here we show that handedness itself can be imposed as an exact local quantum constraint without selecting an axis in spin space. We construct positive-semidefinite, SU(2)-invariant parent Hamiltonians whose complete zero-energy space on a tetrahedron has a prescribed chirality sign, rather than selecting a particular chiral wave function. For spin-1/2 the local term is a rank-one projector onto a chiral tetrahedral singlet, while for arbitrary spin it factorizes as B^dagger B through a singlet-annihilation operator, with a completely characterized kernel given by the span of the globally rotated chiral color-ice states. For coherent states, the same zero-energy condition becomes an S-independent nonlinear constraint in which three spin directions determine the fourth through a Möbius transformation; compositions of these maps define constraint holonomies on extended lattices. Connecting the same local constraint in different ways produces qualitatively different collective regimes: corner-sharing lattices retain exponentially large quantum ground-state kernels, with rigorous lower bounds exceeding conventional ice benchmarks; edge-sharing lattices support subdimensional plane or line zero modes; while triangular constructions suppress nonuniform coherent deformations and contain the complete Anderson tower of tetrahedral magnetic order at exactly zero energy. Two inequivalent triangular coverings further show that harmonic zero-mode counting does not determine the size of the quantum kernel. These results establish a tractable setting in which local handedness, nonlinear constraint geometry, and quantum degeneracy can be disentangled and related directly to the connectivity of the constraint network.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出可将手性本身设定为精确局域量子约束的SU(2)不变父哈密顿量，而无需在自旋空间中选择特定轴。相干态下，该零能条件化为与自旋大小无关的非线性约束，三个自旋方向通过莫比乌斯变换确定第四个方向。不同的局域约束连接方式可产生指数大的量子基态核、低维零模或具有精确零能磁序激发塔等截然不同的集体行为。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 局域约束决定了受挫物质的低能物理，但熟悉的冰型规则约束的是类似通量的量，并且对手性不敏感。本文表明，无需在自旋空间中选定一个轴，也可将手性本身施加为精确的局域量子约束。我们构造了正半定、SU(2)不变的父哈密顿量，其在一个四面体上的完整零能空间具有指定的手性符号，而不是选择某个特定的手性波函数。对于自旋1/2，局域项是投影到一个手性四面体单态的秩一投影算符；对于任意自旋，它可通过单态湮灭算符分解为B†B，其核被完全表征为全局旋转的手性色冰态所张成的空间。对于相干态，同一零能条件变为一个与自旋大小S无关的非线性约束，其中三个自旋方向通过莫比乌斯变换确定第四个方向；这些映射的复合在扩展晶格上定义了约束霍洛诺米。以不同方式连接同一局域约束会产生性质截然不同的集体状态：角共享晶格保留了指数巨大的量子基态核，其严格下界超过常规冰模型的基准；边共享晶格支持低维的平面或线零模；而三角构造则抑制非均匀相干形变，并使四面体磁有序的完整Anderson激发塔恰好处于零能量。两种不等价的三角覆盖还表明，谐波零模计数并不能决定量子核的大小。这些结果建立了一个可处理的研究框架，可在其中分离局域手性、非线性约束几何和量子简并性，并将它们与约束网络的连通性直接联系起来。
full_list.summary: 本文提出可将手性本身设定为精确局域量子约束的SU(2)不变父哈密顿量，而无需在自旋空间中选择特定轴。相干态下，该零能条件化为与自旋大小无关的非线性约束，三个自旋方向通过莫比乌斯变换确定第四个方向。不同的局域约束连接方式可产生指数大的量子基态核、低维零模或具有精确零能磁序激发塔等截然不同的集体行为。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《手性色冰：受挫磁体中的精确局域手性约束与莫比乌斯零模》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Chiral superconductors and competing states across a Lifshitz transition in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene
full_list.title_zh: 菱面体五层石墨烯中跨越利夫希茨转变的手性超导与竞争态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.29873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene hosts a distinctive low-energy electronic structure in which strong Coulomb interactions and nontrivial quantum geometry intertwine to generate exotic quantum states. Recent experiments reported signatures of chiral superconductivity in electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene within the spin- and valley-polarized regime. Here we map the normal-state fermiology surrounding chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene. Quantum oscillation measurements reveal an electrically controlled Lifshitz transition between a simply-connected circular quarter-metal Fermi surface and an annular quarter-metal Fermi surface. The Lifshitz boundary itself shifts with perpendicular magnetic field, consistent with the strongly momentum-dependent orbital magnetic moment of the low-energy band. Approaching the transition from either side, the electron effective mass becomes strongly enhanced, implying the formation of a nearly dispersionless band bottom and a strongly reduced kinetic-energy scale. This singular electronic structure produces a regime of exceptionally strong instability in which chiral superconductivity competes with Wigner crystalline phases and reentrant quantum Hall states. In particular, two superconducting regions with signatures of orbital time-reversal-symmetry breaking lie on opposite sides of the Lifshitz boundary and have comparable transition temperatures, yet the annular-side state is suppressed by a substantially smaller perpendicular magnetic field. Our calculation finds comparable chiral pairing tendencies on the two parent Fermi surfaces while producing a much lower orbital-Zeeman pair-breaking scale and an additional finite-momentum pairing tendency for the annular state. These results identify Fermi-surface topology as a key control parameter for chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene.
full_list.abstract_zh: 菱面体多层石墨烯中的强库仑相互作用与非平庸量子几何可产生丰富的量子态。该研究利用量子振荡描绘菱面体五层石墨烯中手性超导附近的费米面，发现电场可调控圆形与环形四分之一金属费米面之间的利夫希茨转变。转变附近有效质量显著增强，手性超导与维格纳晶体相、重入量子霍尔态发生竞争；环形费米面一侧的超导对垂直磁场更敏感。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 菱面体多层石墨烯具有独特的低能电子结构，其中强库仑相互作用与非平庸量子几何相互交织，从而产生奇异量子态。近期实验已在自旋和谷极化区域的电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯中报告了手性超导的迹象。本文描绘了菱面体五层石墨烯中围绕手性超导的正常态费米面学图景。量子振荡测量揭示了一种可由电场控制的利夫希茨转变，发生于单连通圆形四分之一金属费米面与环形四分之一金属费米面之间。利夫希茨边界本身会随垂直磁场移动，这与低能能带强烈依赖动量的轨道磁矩相一致。从转变两侧接近该转变时，电子有效质量均显著增强，表明形成了近乎无色散的带底以及大幅降低的动能尺度。这种奇异电子结构产生了一个异常强的不稳定性区域，其中手性超导与维格纳晶体相及重入量子霍尔态竞争。特别地，具有轨道时间反演对称性破缺迹象的两个超导区域位于利夫希茨边界两侧，且具有相近的转变温度，但环形一侧的态会被显著更小的垂直磁场压制。我们的计算发现，两种母体费米面上存在可比的手性配对趋势，同时环形态具有低得多的轨道塞曼破对尺度以及额外的有限动量配对趋势。这些结果表明，费米面拓扑是菱面体石墨烯中手性超导的关键控制参数。

full_list.title_en: Creating two-qudit maximally entangled quantum link through bulk
full_list.title_zh: 通过体系统创建两量子位最大纠缠量子链路
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2408.07649v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We design a setup for creating almost maximally entangled two-qudit link between distant nodes which are weakly coupled with the interacting spin-s bulk (processor). We exhibit that such a quantum link between spins of arbitrary spin quantum number can be formed when the system is prepared at sufficiently low temperature. We find that the Heisenberg and the bilinear-biquadratic (BBQ) spin-1 models are the potential candidates to obtain long-distance near-maximal entanglement in equilibrium. Beyond the static regime, we further show that initializing the bulk in a fully polarized state and the link in an appropriate qudit state allows the system to dynamically evolve into a highly entangled state under both Heisenberg and BBQ Hamiltonians. Our findings reveal that both the static and the dynamical protocols presented here remain efficient towards creating highly entangled two-qudit states even if the spin quantum numbers of the bulk is lower than that of the link.
full_list.abstract_zh: 作者设计了一种方案，用于在由相互作用的自旋-s体系统（处理器）弱耦合的远距离节点之间，建立近乎最大纠缠的两量子位链路。结果表明，在足够低的温度下，任意自旋量子数的节点自旋之间都可以形成这种量子链路；其中，海森堡模型和双线性—双二次（BBQ）自旋-1模型尤其适合在平衡态下产生远距离近最大纠缠。进一步地，通过将体系统初始化为完全极化态，并将链路初始化为适当的量子位状态，在两种哈密顿量下均可动态演化出高度纠缠态，且即使体系统的自旋量子数低于链路，方案仍然有效。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们设计了一种装置，用于在由相互作用的自旋-s体系统（处理器）弱耦合的远距离节点之间，创建近乎最大纠缠的两量子位链路。我们证明，当系统被制备在足够低的温度下时，任意自旋量子数的自旋之间都可以形成这种量子链路。我们发现，海森堡模型和双线性—双二次（BBQ）自旋-1模型是在平衡态下获得远距离近最大纠缠的潜在候选者。除了静态情形之外，我们还表明，将体系统初始化为完全极化态，并将链路初始化为适当的量子位状态，可以使系统在海森堡哈密顿量和BBQ哈密顿量作用下动态演化为高度纠缠态。我们的研究结果揭示，即使体系统的自旋量子数低于链路的自旋量子数，本文提出的静态和动态方案在创建高度纠缠的两量子位态方面仍保持高效。

full_list.title_en: Enhanced Diffusion from Twist-Angle Disorder
full_list.title_zh: 扭转角无序导致的扩散增强
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.29062v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the effect of twist-angle disorder on the single-particle properties of twisted bilayer systems. These materials are a natural playground for studying how tiny, uncontrolled spatial variations may become unusually consequential; a local change in the twist geometry can give rise to spatially-correlated alterations of the parent Hamiltonian, which in turn affect the coarse-grained properties of the substrate such as transport and ordering tendencies. In analogy to electrodynamics, where the magnetic field is given by the curl of the vector potential, we model the twist angle as the curl of the relative displacement between the two bilayers. We find that geometric scattering constraints imposed here by the twist structure substantially suppress momentum relaxation relative to mean-rate-matched white noise. We quantify these effects and show that the problem can be mapped onto a non-linear sigma model (NLSM).
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文考察扭转角无序对扭转双层体系单粒子性质的影响。局部扭转几何的微小变化会引起母体哈密顿量的空间关联改变，进而影响输运和有序倾向等粗粒化性质。作者将扭转角建模为两层相对位移的旋度，发现扭转结构施加的几何散射约束相较于平均散射率匹配的白噪声会显著抑制动量弛豫，并将该问题映射到非线性σ模型。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们考察扭转角无序对扭转双层体系单粒子性质的影响。这些材料为研究微小且无法完全控制的空间变化如何产生异常重要的后果提供了天然平台；扭转几何的局部变化可能导致母体哈密顿量发生具有空间关联的改变，进而影响基底的粗粒化性质，例如输运和有序倾向。类比于电动力学中磁场由矢势的旋度给出，我们将扭转角建模为两层双层体系相对位移的旋度。我们发现，这里由扭转结构施加的几何散射约束，相较于平均散射率匹配的白噪声，会大幅抑制动量弛豫。我们量化了这些影响，并表明该问题可以映射为一个非线性σ模型。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《扭转角无序导致的扩散增强》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Light-induced nonconservative static forces in many-body systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Light-induced nonconservative static forces in many-body systems
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.29122v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a quantum many-body system, a periodic drive can often generate effective static forces on the slow collective degrees of freedom. We study the static forces generated by light on electronic order parameters in solid-state systems. We show that the forces can have nonconservative components that originate from dissipation, i.e., optical absorption. This effect is demonstrated in two nontrivial examples. In excitonic insulators, via interband excitations, the light field generates a nonconservative force on the phase of the excitonic order parameter. This force leads to an acceleration of the phase, which manifests as a shift of the photon emission peak from an exciton condensate. In materials with an incommensurate charge density wave, a propagating light field generates a nonconservative force on the phase of its order parameter. It drives the charge density wave into sliding motion, leading to a DC electric current via topological Thouless pumping.

full_list.title_en: Orbital Magnetization and Streda Formula of Interacting Electrons in the Mean-field Approximation
full_list.title_zh: 平均场近似下相互作用电子的轨道磁化与斯特雷达公式
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2510.07001v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the magnetic-field response of interacting electron systems within mean-field theory using perturbation theory. We show that the linear response of the mean-field density-matrix to a weak magnetic field is purely geometric: it depends only on wavefunction derivatives, the Berry connections linking the occupied and unoccupied subspaces, and does not explicitly depend on the interaction potential and the quasiparticle dispersion. This leads to compact, gauge-invariant projector expressions for both the Středa formula and the formula for orbital magnetization. Our calculation explicitly elucidates the role of exchange and self-consistency in defining current vertices for orbital magnetization calculations. Our work establishes a direct connection between mean-field theory, quantum geometry and the non-interacting topological band theory.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文利用微扰理论研究平均场理论下相互作用电子体系对磁场的响应。作者证明，平均场密度矩阵对弱磁场的线性响应具有纯几何性质，只依赖波函数导数以及连接占据与非占据子空间的贝里联络，而不显式依赖相互作用势和准粒子色散。基于此，作者得到斯特雷达公式和轨道磁化公式的紧凑且规范不变的投影算符表达式，并阐明交换作用和自洽性在轨道磁化计算中定义电流顶角的作用。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用微扰理论，在平均场理论框架内研究相互作用电子体系对磁场的响应。我们表明，平均场密度矩阵对弱磁场的线性响应具有纯粹的几何性质：它只依赖于波函数导数以及连接占据子空间和非占据子空间的贝里联络，而不显式依赖于相互作用势和准粒子色散。这一结果导出了斯特雷达公式和轨道磁化公式的紧凑、规范不变的投影算符表达式。我们的计算明确阐明了交换作用和自洽性在定义轨道磁化计算中的电流顶角时所起的作用。我们的工作建立了平均场理论、量子几何与非相互作用拓扑能带理论之间的直接联系。

full_list.title_en: Scalar Spin Chirality from Dissipative Pumping and Lamb Shift Precession
full_list.title_zh: 耗散泵浦与兰姆位移进动产生的标量自旋手征性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circulating currents in triangular triple quantum dots reverse repeatedly with bias even at zero magnetic flux and for a real Hamiltonian, a phenomenon whose origin has remained unclear. We show that dissipative tunneling prepares an orbital pseudospin, while virtual charge fluctuations generate a noncollinear Lamb field that rotates it toward the chiral direction. Bias changes their relative orientation and thereby reverses the current. This reservoir-induced orbital Hanle effect converts a nonchiral orbital polarization into scalar spin chirality, which an exact ground-multiplet identity links to the circulating current. Hierarchical-equations-of-motion calculations show that the low-bias reversal survives beyond the second-order weak-coupling description, while the quadratic growth of chirality after a sudden voltage switch identifies precession. More broadly, time-reversal-odd responses can emerge in open quantum systems from the interplay between dissipative state preparation and coherent precession.
full_list.abstract_zh: 三角三量子点中的环流即使在零磁通和实哈密顿量条件下，也会随偏压反复反向。研究表明，耗散隧穿制备轨道赝自旋，虚电荷涨落产生非共线兰姆场并使其向手征方向旋转；两者相对取向随偏压改变，从而导致电流反向。层级运动方程计算进一步验证了低偏压反向现象，并指出开放量子系统中的耗散态制备与相干进动可共同产生时间反演奇响应。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 三角三量子点中的环流会随偏压反复反向，即使在零磁通和实哈密顿量条件下也是如此，而这一现象的起源此前一直不明确。我们表明，耗散隧穿制备了一种轨道赝自旋，而虚电荷涨落产生非共线的兰姆场，使该赝自旋朝向手征方向旋转。偏压改变这两者的相对取向，进而使电流反向。这种由库诱导的轨道汉勒效应将非手征的轨道极化转换为标量自旋手征性，而一个精确的基态多重态恒等式将后者与环流联系起来。层级运动方程计算显示，低偏压反向在超出二阶弱耦合描述后仍然存在；而突然切换电压后手征性的二次增长则表明存在进动。更广泛地说，开放量子系统中的时间反演奇响应能够源于耗散态制备与相干进动之间的相互作用。

full_list.title_en: Topological pair density waves in kagome superconductors
full_list.title_zh: 笼目超导体中的拓扑配对密度波
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.29156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pair density wave (PDW) is an unconventional superconducting state exhibiting periodic pairing modulations due to pairing with finite momentum Q. In two dimensions, multiple Q components of the PDW can have a non-trivial relative phase, breaking time-reversal symmetry and resulting in a topological electronic structure. Here we review progress on exploring such topological PDWs (TPDWs) and discuss their potential realization in kagome superconductors. We first introduce the concept of a TPDW starting from the Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) state and examine the challenges toward its realization. We then discuss the possibility of a TPDW in the kagome lattice, which intertwines with chiral superconductivity and loop currents, thus connecting to models describing the quantum anomalous Hall effect. Furthermore, we review the experimental signatures of a TPDW in AV3Sb5 (A = Cs, Rb, K) superconductors and highlight related quantum effects, including switchable chiral pairing modulations, Bogoliubov Fermi states, the superconducting diode effect, and the anomalous thermal Hall effect. Finally, we project the future research opportunities of this correlated topological quantum phase and discuss its broad implications for finite-momentum pairing, topological matter, and chiral superconductivity.
full_list.abstract_zh: 配对密度波是具有非常规超导性的状态，其配对以有限动量Q发生，从而导致周期性配对调制。在二维体系中，配对密度波的多个Q分量可以具有非平凡相对相位，破缺时间反演对称性并形成拓扑电子结构。本文回顾拓扑配对密度波的研究进展及其在笼目超导体中的潜在实现，讨论其与手性超导和环流的交织，以及在AV₃Sb₅中的实验信号，包括可切换的手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应和反常热霍尔效应。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 配对密度波（PDW）是一种非常规超导态，其特征是由于以有限动量Q进行配对而产生周期性配对调制。在二维体系中，PDW的多个Q分量可以具有非平凡的相对相位，从而破缺时间反演对称性并形成拓扑电子结构。在这里，我们回顾对这类拓扑配对密度波（TPDW）的探索进展，并讨论其在笼目超导体中的潜在实现。我们首先从Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov（FFLO）态出发介绍TPDW的概念，并考察其实现所面临的挑战。随后，我们讨论笼目晶格中出现TPDW的可能性；这种状态与手性超导和环流交织在一起，从而与描述量子反常霍尔效应的模型相联系。此外，我们回顾AV₃Sb₅（A=Cs、Rb、K）超导体中TPDW的实验特征，并强调相关量子效应，包括可切换的手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应以及反常热霍尔效应。最后，我们展望这一关联拓扑量子相未来的研究机会，并讨论其对有限动量配对、拓扑物质和手性超导研究的广泛意义。

full_list.title_en: Stable Topology in Exactly Flat Bands
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Stable Topology in Exactly Flat Bands
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.12258v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological flat bands (FBs) offer an ideal platform for realizing exotic topological phases and exploring quantum geometric effects, yet their realization with both exact flatness and stable topology in local lattice models has been hindered by fundamental no-go theorems. The obstruction is also manifested as the absence of exact Gaussian TNS representations for topological insulators and superconductors. Here, we overcome this barrier by demonstrating the existence of critical topological FBs (CTFBs) in finite-range hopping models. They saturate the no-go theorems via a unique structure of Bloch wavefunctions: While continuous over the whole Brillouin zone, the projector P(k) onto FBs is non-analytic at isolated band touching points. Filling such CTFBs yields short-range entangled topological states with power-law correlations due to the non-analyticity. We then establish a general symmetry-based principle to systematically construct CTFBs that carry desired topological invariants in given space groups. It utilizes the bipartite structure and requires no further fine-tuning, and the topology is robust against arbitrary symmetry-preserving gap-opening perturbations. Remarkably, independent tuning of the quantum geometry is allowed. Examples exhibiting Chern numbers 1, 2, 3, 6, in 2D, and strong Z₂ indices in 2D and 3D are demonstrated for concreteness. An automated algorithm further identifies more than 50,000 symmetry-indicated CTFBs, including crystalline and higher-order topological ones. In the end, we show that the bipartite structure naturally endows the filled CTFB states with exact TNS representations with finite bond dimensions. By bridging the topological band theory to TNS methods, CTFB provides a novel tractable starting point for exploring strongly correlated topological matter, with potential relevance to realistic material realizations.

full_list.title_en: Accelerated Quantum-Assisted Selected Configuration Interaction via Fast-Annealing-Based Determinant Selection
full_list.title_zh: 基于快速退火行列式选择的加速量子辅助选择性组态相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Full configuration interaction (FCI) provides exact electronic structure within a given atomic basis, but its computational cost grows exponentially with the number of spin orbitals. Selected configuration interaction (SCI) methods alleviate this limitation by retaining only the most important Slater determinants. However, the repeated identification of important determinants remains a major computational bottleneck. We present a quantum assisted selected configuration interaction (QASCI) method that combines SCI with graph based block diagonalization (GBBD) of FCI Hamiltonian. The GBBD method partitions FCI Hamiltonian into independent blocks, within which determinant selection problem is formulated as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem. The QUBO problems for selecting determinants to construct SCI space are iteratively solved using a fast annealing approach. We benchmark method on H8-H18 hydrogen chains and Li2S in STO3G basis. For Hn chains, chemical accuracy is achieved while retaining only a small fraction of Slater determinants, and this fraction decreases with increasing n, despite the exponential growth of the FCI Hilbert space. For Li2S, QASCI results remain within chemical accuracy while retaining substantially fewer determinants than the full FCI space. We apply QASCI to N2 using the 631G basis, considering both active orbital and full orbital treatments. The full orbital QASCI calculation, using 50000 determinants, yields a lower ground state energy than an FCI calculation within an active space comprising 12 spin orbitals and 12 electrons. These results demonstrate that the combination of QASCI and the GBBD approach can substantially reduce computational cost of determinant selection while maintaining the accuracy of FCI based electronic structure calculations, thereby enabling accurate calculations in larger orbital spaces.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在给定原子基组内，全组态相互作用方法能够提供精确电子结构，但其计算成本随自旋轨道数呈指数增长。本文提出量子辅助选择性组态相互作用方法，将选择性组态相互作用与全组态相互作用哈密顿量的图基块对角化相结合，并将行列式选择转化为二次无约束二元优化问题，再通过快速退火迭代求解。对氢链、Li₂S和N₂的测试表明，该方法在显著减少行列式数量的同时保持化学精度，并可扩展至更大的轨道空间。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 全组态相互作用（FCI）方法能够在给定原子基组内提供精确的电子结构，但其计算成本会随自旋轨道数量呈指数增长。选择性组态相互作用（SCI）方法通过仅保留最重要的斯莱特行列式来缓解这一限制。然而，反复识别重要行列式仍然是一个主要的计算瓶颈。我们提出一种量子辅助选择性组态相互作用（QASCI）方法，将SCI与FCI哈密顿量的基于图的块对角化（GBBD）相结合。GBBD方法将FCI哈密顿量划分为相互独立的区块，并在每个区块内将行列式选择问题表述为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题。用于选择行列式并构建SCI空间的QUBO问题通过快速退火方法进行迭代求解。我们在STO-3G基组下对H₈—H₁₈氢链和Li₂S进行了方法基准测试。对于Hn氢链，QASCI仅保留一小部分斯莱特行列式即可达到化学精度；尽管FCI希尔伯特空间呈指数增长，这一比例仍会随着n增大而降低。对于Li₂S，在保留远少于完整FCI空间的行列式数量时，QASCI结果仍处于化学精度范围内。我们进一步使用6-31G基组研究N₂，同时考虑活性轨道和全轨道两种处理方式。采用50000个行列式的全轨道QASCI计算，得到的基态能量低于包含12个自旋轨道和12个电子的活性空间FCI计算结果。这些结果表明，QASCI与GBBD方法相结合，能够在保持基于FCI的电子结构计算精度的同时，大幅降低行列式选择的计算成本，从而使更大轨道空间中的精确计算成为可能。

full_list.title_en: Boundary Quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov Equations and Integrability of Quantum Field Theories with Time-Dependent Bulk and Boundary Coupling Strengths
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Boundary Quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov Equations and Integrability of Quantum Field Theories with Time-Dependent Bulk and Boundary Coupling Strengths
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.31080v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The generalized Bethe ansatz framework formulated in [P. R. Pasnoori, Phys. Rev. B 112, L060409 (2025)] provides a unified framework to find exact solutions to quantum many-body systems with time-dependent coupling strengths with periodic boundary conditions. In this work we extend this framework to the case of open boundary conditions where in addition to the time-dependent interactions in the bulk, the boundary conditions are explicitly time-dependent. We show that for integrable time-dependent bulk coupling strengths, the generalized Bethe ansatz framework provides the time-dependent boundary conditions compatible with integrability and reduces the time-dependent Schrodinger equation to a set of matrix difference equations called the boundary quantum Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov (BqKZ) equations. The solution to the BqKZ equations provides the explicit form of the exact wavefunction. We further show that the RG invariants of the corresponding static model identify with the dynamical invariants in the time-dependent model.

full_list.title_en: Surrogate model driven RL optimization of the TWOCRYST crystal angular alignment
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Surrogate model driven RL optimization of the TWOCRYST crystal angular alignment
full_list.abstract: The TWOCRYST double-crystal experimental setup exploits planar channeling to extract halo protons from the LHC circulating beam and steer them onto a target followed by a crystal. TWOCRYST paves the way for possible future experiments at the LHC based on similar machine layout, such as the ALADDIN experiment that aims to measure the electric and magnetic dipole moments of short-lived charm baryons, in particular Λc+. Optimal double-channeling performance requires microradian-level alignment of the Target Collimator Crystal for Precession (TCCP), a task currently performed manually over extensive parameter sweeps. We develop MDHaloEnv, a Gymnasium-based reinforcement learning environment that synthesizes multi-modal sensor data from LHC beam tests at beam energies from 450 GeV to 3 TeV, with the aim of improving future commissioning efficiency of double-channeling experiments. We propose theoretically grounded improvements to the Markov Decision Process formulation, including a reward function that mitigates credit assignment ambiguity, noise-derived convergence thresholds based on impulse noise characteristics, and a smoothness penalty scaled to observation noise variance. Proximal Policy Optimization agents were trained on the data-driven environment and evaluated on the June 2025 450 GeV dataset. This work presents the application of deep reinforcement learning to TCCP crystal alignment in the TWOCRYST experiment, and establishes the data-driven surrogate paradigm as a foundation for future multi-energy and multi-actuator extensions.

full_list.title_en: Topological and spin-orbit effects on orbital moments in ultra-thin magnetic films
full_list.title_zh: 超薄磁性薄膜中轨道磁矩的拓扑与自旋-轨道效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological orbital moments (TOMs) are a direct hallmark of a magnetic texture with a non-trivial spin topology. In addition to giving insight into the topology of the magnetic texture, TOMs could also be used to manipulate magnetic structures with a compensated total spin moment. Experimental evidence of TOMs has been provided via transport measurements of the Hall effect in intercalated van-der-Waals materials. However, a direct observation of TOMs is still missing. Another complication arises for the unambiguous proof of the topological origin since orbital moments can also occur due to spin-orbit coupling. Here, we use first-principles electronic structure theory to investigate the origin of orbital moments in different compensated spin structures with a non-trivial topology. We focus on ultrathin magnetic films at surfaces such as Pd/Mn bilayers on Re(0001) which represent ideal model systems for the detection of TOMs since it is possible to apply experimental techniques with local resolution of magnetic properties such as spin-polarized scanning tunneling microscopy. Due to its trivial topology we use the row-wise antiferromagnetic (RW-AFM) state in a hexagonal monolayer to analyze the spin-orbit induced contributions. The triple-Q (3Q) state is a superposition state of three RW-AFM (1Q) states and thus electronically similar, however, due to its non-trivial spin topology it exhibits TOMs. The comparison between these two spin states allows us to disentangle the topological and spin-orbit contributions to the orbital moments. We find that TOMs have an important contribution in spin-compensated systems, since the spin-orbit coupling induced orbital moments are nearly compensated. First-principles calculations for atomic-scale skyrmion lattices in Fe monolayers on different surfaces exhibit the same general trend found for the 3Q state.
full_list.abstract_zh: 拓扑轨道磁矩是具有非平庸自旋拓扑的磁织构的直接标志，但其直接观测及与自旋-轨道耦合贡献的区分仍具挑战。本文以第一性原理方法比较补偿自旋结构中的行式反铁磁态与三重Q态，分离轨道磁矩的拓扑和自旋-轨道来源。结果表明，在自旋补偿体系中，自旋-轨道耦合诱导的轨道磁矩近乎相互补偿，因而拓扑轨道磁矩尤为重要。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑轨道磁矩（TOM）是具有非平庸自旋拓扑的磁织构的直接标志。除能够揭示磁织构的拓扑性质外，TOM还可用于操控总自旋矩得到补偿的磁结构。通过对插层范德华材料中霍尔效应的输运测量，实验上已获得TOM存在的证据。然而，对TOM的直接观测仍然缺失。由于轨道磁矩也可由自旋-轨道耦合产生，对其拓扑起源进行明确证明还面临另一项复杂因素。本文利用第一性原理电子结构理论，研究了具有非平庸拓扑的不同补偿自旋结构中轨道磁矩的来源。我们重点研究表面上的超薄磁性薄膜，例如Re(0001)上的Pd/Mn双层；这类体系是探测TOM的理想模型体系，因为可以采用具有磁性质局域分辨能力的实验技术，如自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜。由于其拓扑平庸，我们利用六角单层中的行式反铁磁（RW-AFM）态分析自旋-轨道诱导的贡献。三重Q（3Q）态是三个RW-AFM（1Q）态的叠加态，因此在电子结构上相似；然而，由于其具有非平庸自旋拓扑，它表现出TOM。对这两种自旋态的比较使我们能够分离轨道磁矩中的拓扑贡献和自旋-轨道贡献。我们发现，TOM在自旋补偿体系中具有重要贡献，因为自旋-轨道耦合诱导的轨道磁矩几乎得到补偿。针对不同表面上Fe单层中原子尺度斯格明子晶格的第一性原理计算，也呈现出在3Q态中发现的相同总体趋势。
full_list.summary: 拓扑轨道磁矩是具有非平庸自旋拓扑的磁织构的直接标志，但其直接观测及与自旋-轨道耦合贡献的区分仍具挑战。本文以第一性原理方法比较补偿自旋结构中的行式反铁磁态与三重Q态，分离轨道磁矩的拓扑和自旋-轨道来源。结果表明，在自旋补偿体系中，自旋-轨道耦合诱导的轨道磁矩近乎相互补偿，因而拓扑轨道磁矩尤为重要。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文使用第一性原理电子结构计算，研究超薄磁性薄膜中非平庸自旋拓扑与自旋轨道耦合对轨道磁矩的贡献。通过比较不同补偿自旋结构，尝试区分拓扑轨道磁矩和普通自旋轨道耦合诱导轨道磁矩的来源。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的磁性材料、非共线磁性、自旋轨道耦合、拓扑磁态和自旋哈密顿量方向高度相关。其区分拓扑效应与自旋轨道背景贡献的思路，可用于团队关注的斯格明子及拓扑磁性体系。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步研究轨道磁矩与Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用、磁阻尼及可观测输运信号之间的定量关联，并构建包含轨道自由度的有效自旋模型。
full_list.method_point: 作者以超薄磁性薄膜中的补偿自旋结构为对象，使用第一性原理计算比较行列式反铁磁态与三重Q态的局域轨道磁矩和空间纹理。通过分别关闭或保留自旋轨道耦合、分析自旋拓扑和轨道磁矩空间分布，区分由非平庸自旋织构产生的拓扑轨道贡献与SOC诱导贡献；重点结论是自旋补偿体系中的SOC轨道矩近乎抵消，使拓扑项成为主要可观测信号。
full_list.related_work: 该工作呼应非共线磁性、轨道磁化、Berry曲率和拓扑磁纹理研究，也与Hongjun Xiang关于反铁磁、交替磁性、拓扑磁态及群论分析的方向一致。相较机器学习自旋势，它没有学习动力学能量面，而是用高精度第一性原理分解轨道磁矩来源；与Hongyu Yu和Xin-Gao Gong的等变模型结合时，关键挑战是同时保持自旋旋转、空间对称和SOC时间反演变换。
full_list.implication: 可在CrI3、CrSBr及二维交替磁体中构造螺旋、skyrmion和多Q自旋纹理，采用DFT+U、非共线自旋和SOC计算轨道磁矩、Berry曲率及磁光响应。以不同薄膜厚度、应变、层间滑移和外电场生成训练集，训练带自旋张量输出的equivariant GNN预测局域轨道矩；用Wannier插值复核总磁化和反常霍尔响应，并比较拓扑纹理、SOC开关和实验XMCD信号。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Trust Reinforced Transformer Framework for Trust Aware Autonomous Navigation with Adaptive Path Planning
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum Trust Reinforced Transformer Framework for Trust Aware Autonomous Navigation with Adaptive Path Planning
full_list.abstract: Autonomous navigation in dynamic traffic requires accurate motion prediction, uncertainty-aware risk assessment, efficient path optimization, and adaptive control. This paper proposes QTR-Net, a Quantum-Trust Reinforced Transformer framework that integrates Transformer-based trajectory prediction, dynamic trust estimation, trust occupancy mapping, kinodynamic RRT* candidate generation, QUBO formulation, QAOA-assisted path selection, and PPO-based adaptive objective weighting in a unified closed-loop architecture. Surrounding-vehicle histories are processed to estimate future trajectories, while behavioral consistency and predicted risk are converted into trust scores and projected onto a trust occupancy map. Twenty dynamically feasible candidate paths are generated, and the top five candidates are optimized through a hybrid QAOA-assisted selection stage. PPO dynamically adjusts safety, efficiency, smoothness, travel-time, and trust-related weights before the selected path is converted into steering, throttle, and braking commands. The framework was evaluated using a CARLA-compatible high-fidelity simulation adapter across Town03 and Town05, three weather conditions, three traffic densities, five random seeds, nine baseline and ablation settings, and 20 episodes per experimental cell, yielding 16,200 completed runs without execution failures. The complete QTR-Net achieved a 65.33% success rate, 34.67% collision rate, 11.841 s mean travel time, 67.975 m mean path length, 2.780 s minimum time-to-collision, and 0.01786 m lane deviation. Ablation analysis showed that the Transformer substantially improved path efficiency, lateral stability, steering smoothness, safety margin, and trust exposure, while PPO, QAOA, trust modeling, and candidate diversity significantly influenced complementary behavioral metrics. Friedman and Holm-corrected Wilcoxon tests confirmed significant differences among configurations. The results demonstrate the feasibility of integrated quantum-assisted, trust-aware, and reinforcement-learning-based navigation.

full_list.title_en: Development of an Autonomous AI Coding Agent using Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and Gemini LLM Frameworks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Development of an Autonomous AI Coding Agent using Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and Gemini LLM Frameworks
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.29096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ongoing changes in software engineering requirements have created a substantial need for automated tools which can create secure source code from natural language input. The performance of traditional Large Language Models (LLMs) becomes limited by their "one-shot" capability which results in logical hallucinations together with reduced algorithmic performance during complicated operations. The research presents an autonomous AI Coding Agent which establishes a connection between LLM-generated content and production-ready software through its organized methodology for decision making. Our framework uses the Gemini 2.5 Flash API for essential reasoning capabilities while employing a tailored Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) method to solve code generation challenges as a search operation. The agent uses a "Self-Critic" evaluator system to test different implementation methods which it ranks according to their accuracy and difficulty level before it improves its operational framework through backpropagation. The system operates through a Flask-based web interface which delivers instant feedback together with syntax highlighting features. Our experimental results show that the MCTS-based method achieves a 92% success rate on complex logical prompts while surpassing standard zero-shot generation models.

full_list.title_en: Chemically Resolved Topological Coordinates Link Structural Dynamics and Configurational Thermodynamics
full_list.title_zh: 化学分辨拓扑坐标连接结构动力学与构型热力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.30523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic coordinates specify a structure, but they do not reveal how chemical connectivity across several length scales relates to atomic motion and configurational energy ordering. We formulate chemically directed persistent homology at four resolutions---complete networks, individual sites, spatial fields, and substitutional arrangements---while retaining the chemical identity and length scale of each connectivity feature. In ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectories of δ- and γ-CsPbI₃ at five temperatures spanning 500--700 K, the corner-sharing γ network has a lower Pb--I restoring stiffness and permits larger iodide excursions, yet iodide positional correlations decay 2.27 times more slowly and Pb-network topology retains memory 1.63 times longer than in the edge-sharing δ phase. Local softness and loss of network memory are therefore distinct. At individual sites, rare γ-phase Pb environments with a δ-like Cs-cage connectivity precede 0.17 mathringA greater Pb displacement over the subsequent 0.5 ps. The same Pb-network coordinate resolves disruption of corner-sharing connectivity across a 2560-atom δ|γ boundary. In substituted CsPbI₃, compact dopant arrangements undergo greater cooperative host relaxation and lie lower in density-functional-theory (DFT) energy than dispersed arrangements of the same composition. SchNet and Allegro model families with comparable energy errors encode opposite ordering along this coordinate, and 61 of 247 supplied models with errors below 1 meV atom⁻¹ on separate test structures reverse the DFT relation. Because relative configurational energies set Boltzmann populations, chemical network topology links structure to physical response and tests whether learned energy models preserve DFT configurational ordering even when their average errors are small.
full_list.abstract_zh: 原子坐标能够描述结构，却难以揭示多尺度化学连通性与原子运动及构型能量排序的关系。研究提出四种分辨率下的化学定向持续同调方法，并将其应用于 CsPbI₃ 的从头算分子动力学、相界面和掺杂构型分析。结果显示，化学网络拓扑既可预测局部结构动力学，也可检验机器学习能量模型是否保留 DFT 所给出的构型相对能量排序。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 原子坐标规定了一种结构，但并未揭示跨越多个长度尺度的化学连通性如何与原子运动和构型能量排序相关。我们在四种分辨率下构建了化学定向持续同调：完整网络、单个位点、空间场以及取代构型，同时保留每个连通性特征的化学身份和长度尺度。在覆盖500至700 K五个温度的δ相和γ相 CsPbI₃ 从头算分子动力学轨迹中，角共享的γ相网络具有更低的 Pb-I 回复刚度，并允许更大的碘离子位移；然而，与边共享的δ相相比，碘离子的位置相关性衰减慢2.27倍，Pb网络拓扑保留记忆的时间长1.63倍。因此，局域软化与网络记忆丧失是不同的概念。在单个位点层面，具有δ相类 Cs 笼连通性的罕见γ相 Pb环境，会在随后0.5 ps内先于大0.17埃的 Pb 位移出现。同一 Pb 网络坐标还解析了一个2560原子δ|γ边界处角共享连通性的破坏。在掺杂的 CsPbI₃ 中，紧凑的掺杂原子排列经历更强的协同宿主晶格弛豫，并且相较于相同组分的分散排列具有更低的密度泛函理论（DFT）能量。具有相当能量误差的 SchNet 和 Allegro 模型家族沿该坐标编码出相反的排序；在247个所提供模型中，61个模型虽然在独立测试结构上的误差低于每原子1 meV，却颠倒了 DFT 关系。由于相对构型能量决定玻尔兹曼布居，化学网络拓扑将结构与物理响应连接起来，并检验学习型能量模型即使在平均误差很小时，是否仍保留 DFT 的构型排序。
full_list.summary: 原子坐标能够描述结构，却难以揭示多尺度化学连通性与原子运动及构型能量排序的关系。研究提出四种分辨率下的化学定向持续同调方法，并将其应用于 CsPbI₃ 的从头算分子动力学、相界面和掺杂构型分析。结果显示，化学网络拓扑既可预测局部结构动力学，也可检验机器学习能量模型是否保留 DFT 所给出的构型相对能量排序。
full_list.focus_summary: 本文提出化学分辨的拓扑坐标和持久同调方法，用于连接原子结构拓扑、结构动力学与构型热力学。基于500至700 K的CsPbI3第一性原理分子动力学轨迹，研究比较了δ相和γ相中的碘原子运动、网络记忆、局域环境和相界面结构演化。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的卤化物钙钛矿、第一性原理分子动力学、动态缺陷、相变、界面结构及机器学习材料描述符方向高度相关。其化学分辨拓扑分析可用于识别局域结构环境、离子迁移通道、相变前驱态和缺陷诱导动力学机制。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可将该类拓扑坐标用于机器学习势训练、主动学习采样和钙钛矿离子迁移路径预测，并与非绝热分子动力学结合研究载流子-晶格耦合。进一步建议分析缺陷、应变和光照条件下相界面拓扑记忆与载流子复合之间的关系。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《化学分辨拓扑坐标连接结构动力学与构型热力学》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Probing spin order via magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions
full_list.title_zh: 通过量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的磁振子传输探测自旋序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.29015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional material platforms now host a remarkable array of exotic correlated phases, from unconventional superconductivity to fractional Chern insulators. Probing magnetic order in these systems is essential for understanding their underlying physics, yet dilute spin densities render conventional magnetic probes ineffective. Spin waves, or magnons, in quantum Hall ferromagnets (QHFM) have proven effective for probing the magnetic order in various symmetry-broken quantum Hall (QH) phases in graphene systems, but previous works have been limited to homojunction configurations within a single material. Here, we demonstrate magnon transmission across a monolayer-bilayer graphene quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunction - the first magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions, using one material as a magnon source to probe magnetic order in a distinct material. Generating magnons in monolayer graphene (MLG) at ν = 1, we detect their transmission through bilayer graphene (BLG) via nonlocal voltage measurements, revealing spin order in BLG symmetry-broken quantum Hall states. The transmission exhibits hallmark magnon signatures: a sharp onset at the Zeeman energy and systematic variation with Landau level filling, including suppression at ν = 4 and 8 where spin polarization vanishes. Our findings establish heterojunction magnon transmission as a powerful, modular probe of magnetic order, opening new avenues for investigating exotic quantum states across the rapidly expanding family of two-dimensional materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 二维材料平台如今包含从非常规超导性到分数陈绝缘体在内的多种奇异关联相，但稀疏自旋密度使传统磁性探测手段难以奏效。本文实现了单层石墨烯与双层石墨烯量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的磁振子传输，并利用单层石墨烯作为磁振子源探测双层石墨烯中的磁序。非局域电压测量显示，磁振子传输具有塞曼能量处的尖锐起始以及随朗道能级填充变化的系统特征，并在自旋极化消失的ν=4和8处受到抑制。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 二维材料平台如今承载着一系列引人注目的奇异关联相，从非常规超导性到分数陈绝缘体。探测这些体系中的磁序对于理解其底层物理至关重要，但稀疏的自旋密度使传统磁性探测手段难以发挥作用。量子霍尔铁磁体中的自旋波，即磁振子，已被证明能够有效探测石墨烯体系中各种对称性破缺量子霍尔相的磁序，但以往研究仅限于单一材料内部的同质结构型。在这里，我们展示了单层石墨烯—双层石墨烯量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的磁振子传输，这是首次实现跨量子霍尔铁磁异质结的磁振子传输，并使用一种材料作为磁振子源来探测另一种不同材料中的磁序。我们在填充因子ν=1的单层石墨烯中产生磁振子，并通过非局域电压测量探测其穿过双层石墨烯的传输，从而揭示双层石墨烯对称性破缺量子霍尔态中的自旋序。该传输表现出磁振子的标志性特征：在塞曼能量处出现尖锐起始，并随朗道能级填充发生系统性变化；在自旋极化消失的ν=4和8处，传输受到抑制。我们的研究确立了异质结磁振子传输作为探测磁序的一种强大而模块化的手段，为研究不断扩展的二维材料家族中的奇异量子态开辟了新途径。
full_list.summary: 二维材料平台如今包含从非常规超导性到分数陈绝缘体在内的多种奇异关联相，但稀疏自旋密度使传统磁性探测手段难以奏效。本文实现了单层石墨烯与双层石墨烯量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的磁振子传输，并利用单层石墨烯作为磁振子源探测双层石墨烯中的磁序。非局域电压测量显示，磁振子传输具有塞曼能量处的尖锐起始以及随朗道能级填充变化的系统特征，并在自旋极化消失的ν=4和8处受到抑制。
full_list.focus_summary: 本文研究了量子霍尔铁磁体异质结中的磁子传输，首次展示了单层石墨烯到双层石墨烯量子霍尔铁磁体中的磁子跨界面传播。通过非局域电压测量，研究揭示了双层石墨烯中不同对称性破缺量子霍尔态的自旋序信息。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的二维磁性、磁性异质结、自旋输运、非共线磁性和自旋相关量子功能材料方向密切相关。磁子跨界面传输及其对磁序的探测思路，可启发二维范德华磁体、磁性超晶格和拓扑磁性界面的输运研究。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步使用第一性原理、有效自旋哈密顿量和自旋动力学模拟研究界面交换耦合、磁子散射及自旋-晶格耦合机制。也可探索应变、层间滑移、栅压和缺陷对磁子透射率与自旋信号的调控。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过量子霍尔铁磁异质结中的磁振子传输探测自旋序》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Understanding Deep Learning via Notions of Rank
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Understanding Deep Learning via Notions of Rank
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2408.02111v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Despite the extreme popularity of deep learning in science and industry, its formal understanding is limited. This thesis puts forth notions of rank as key for developing a theory of deep learning, focusing on the fundamental aspects of generalization and expressiveness. In particular, we establish that gradient-based training can induce an implicit regularization towards low rank for several neural network architectures, and demonstrate empirically that this phenomenon may facilitate an explanation of generalization over natural data (e.g., audio, images, and text). Then, we characterize the ability of graph neural networks to model interactions via a notion of rank, which is commonly used for quantifying entanglement in quantum physics. A central tool underlying these results is a connection between neural networks and tensor factorizations. Practical implications of our theory for designing explicit regularization schemes and data preprocessing algorithms are presented.
full_list.summary: 论文从秩、张量分解和隐式正则化角度研究深度学习的表达能力、泛化能力以及图神经网络对相互作用的建模能力。主要结论是低秩倾向和相关理论工具有助于解释神经网络训练与泛化现象。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文从秩、张量分解和隐式正则化角度研究深度学习的表达能力、泛化能力以及图神经网络对相互作用的建模能力。主要结论是低秩倾向和相关理论工具有助于解释神经网络训练与泛化现象。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的图神经网络、等变神经网络和机器学习哈密顿量研究存在基础方法层面的联系，但论文不针对材料体系或电子结构问题。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可关注其关于图神经网络表达能力和张量分解的理论结果，并评估其对材料图网络、等变模型和电子哈密顿量预测中的模型压缩及正则化设计的启发。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：图神经网络结构—性质建模。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《Understanding Deep Learning via Notions of Rank》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Understanding Deep Learning via Entropy Space Theory
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Understanding Deep Learning via Entropy Space Theory
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.29279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning is often criticized for its theoretical research lagging behind practice. To make deep learning easier to understand, the entropy space theory is first introduced here. The entropy space can cover all the possibilities of any deep learning model by topological structure. It is independent of network parameters. Through the designed fundamental operations and norm, entropy space is proven to be a normed space within the formal axiomatic framework. Based on the theory, a unified coordinate system is proposed. It can coordinatize every state of a model and rank them by compression of the maximal value of information entropy. The theory offers a novel priori framework for mathematical fundamentals of deep learning.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Benchmarking Quantum Feature Encoding Strategies for Binary Classification with QSVM
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Benchmarking Quantum Feature Encoding Strategies for Binary Classification with QSVM
full_list.abstract: The way in which classical data are encoded into quantum states plays a significant role in both classification performance and quantum circuit complexity in Quantum Machine Learning. In this study, the effects of different quantum feature encoding strategies on Quantum Support Vector Machine performance were investigated using five binary classification datasets. In particular, the statistical relationships between features were incorporated into quantum circuits through RY (θ) and controlled-RY (θ) gates, and this approach was compared with conventional quantum feature maps. The results demonstrate that incorporating statistical relationships into the encoding process can influence classification performance. However, more complex and densely entangled circuits do not necessarily yield higher performance. In addition, a composite evaluation metric was employed to jointly assess predictive performance, generalization, and circuit cost. The findings across the five datasets indicate that the choice of quantum feature encoding strategy should account for the underlying structure of the data and that predictive performance should be evaluated together with quantum circuit complexity.
